question: Find the surface area (in dm²) of a cuboid whose length is 4.2 m, breadth is 30 dm and height is 180 cm.
solution:
**Given:**

Length (l) = 4.2 m = 42 dm

Breadth (b) = 30 dm

Height (h) = 180 cm = 18 dm

**Formula used:**

Surface Area (SA) of Cuboid = 2 [(l × b) + (b × h) + (h × l)]

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21c56be99c194704d2d6ccbd9c084eb1d0b77c62319da2957fd44cbff1d253c0.png] 

SA = 2 [(42 × 30) + (30 × 18) + (18 × 42)]

⇒ SA = 2 [(1260) + (540) + (756)]

⇒ SA = 2 [2256]

⇒ SA = 2 × 2556 = 5112 dm²

**∴ The surface area (in dm2) of a cuboid is 5112 dm².**
